reviews.author: Kelly Sunter
reviews.text: This was my first time attending this restaurant in Metro Centre and it was very disappointing. For my daughter's birthday we decided to go here, she is obsessed with ramen noodles. Tried dishes she's had before in the UK and USA and it was very underwhelming or terrible as she describes it. It did not look nice. The broth and noodles were very hot while the egg, meat, and vegetables were cold. The ramen bowl was half filled. The broth was meant to be darker and it was pale, not dark enough for black garlic. My main meal dish didn't arrive and I had to chase the server as noone noticed. My daughter begged I did not tell them how awful her meal was. The server on checking apologised and said i did not have to pay for my daughters meal owing to my meal not arriving and my daughter had finished her ramen bu then. The situation spolit our dining experience, we wanted to eat together. We would never go back again and had to go elsewhere for lunch. Environment looked nice and chop sticks good quality. It was too loud where we were sitting from the music to hear each other speak. Also the light did not have a shade on and situated middle of the table and far too bright. It triggered a headache. Awful dining experience. The server explained they dont know what happened to my order whether it got lost or simply the chef forgot. Worrisome considering it was not busy on arrival. I was really looking forward to trying here I would never recommend it to anyone.

We actually ordered two of his recommendations, so a big shout-out to him for helping us decide when we wanted half the menu 😂👏🏻 The portion size is proper good too! Good food, good vibes and lovely service… it wasn’t our first visit, and it definitely won’t be our last! 🍣🍜 If your shopping trips tend to turn into lunch or dinner plans, save Maki & Ramen for your next Lakeside visit! ✨

reviews.text: Ordered sushi for dinner and there is no soy sauce nor wasabi. This happened multiple times with this restaurant. We even gave them a call to highlight it and we were told by their staff it’s part of the sushi order anyways.. and essentially we were told that we don’t have to call to ask for wasabi & soy sauce as it’s standard and part of the order. If anyone out there knows about sushi and Japanese cuisine, sushi without wasabi and soy sauce is like steak without seasoning !! When tried calling the restaurant after receiving the order, they don’t pick up our call. Reported to deliveroo. Don’t accept the order if you cannot fulfill. Ppl order for delivery via food based apps for convenience. Given this happened multiple times it’s quite unacceptable.

reviews.text: I went for dinner there today, food was delicious but the service was quiet bad. I've ordered 2 ramen and 2 side dishes, I've made sure to mention that we would start with the side dishes and then the ramen, specifying to the manager who was taking orders on her pad, the extra beef topping that would go for both. Few minutes later they serve us one ramen. We ask if the second one is coming they say yes. Then the manager comes 5 minutes later, saying we ordered only one ramen, wish I anwser that we ordered two, she ask if we could have this one for now, as it will go soggy. I tell her that I won't be eating the ramen by myself while my partner is watching. She just storms off without a word. When the bill came we noticed that she charged us for three ramen, the other waitress took care of rectifying the bill, we saw that manager coming to her with a smirk to ask what was going on. At the end it got sorted, but we felt that this lady managing, and taking order, needs way more training in customer service, and stop trying to sneakly scam people by adding more to the bill to cover for her own mistake. None of less food was delicious especially the teriyaki chiken, I would've recommended this restaurant, if it wasn't for this women.

reviews.text: Amazing and delicious food!! Staff were super friendly. Food came really quickly too. A great place to go when you want some great food (Picture is black garlic tonkotsu)

reviews.author: Razan Wazwaz
reviews.text: It was wonderful. The server was incredibly welcoming and friendly. There wasn't a lot of atmosphere, but I did go at a quieter time, so it was unsurprising. The food was served quickly and it was delicious. And they had very clear halal options which was lovely. I got steak tataki. It is a bit pricier, but it's high quality so I do believe it is worth it.

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant, my new fav over wags

reviews.text: Authentic..Affordable…Excellent service from the staffs especially Dave..

reviews.author: P A
reviews.text: Been to Maki & Ramen several times and it’s always great! The food is delicious and arrived fast & fresh, the staff are always so lovely - especially Yuya - and the lunch special is amazing value! Highly recommend this restaurant, they deserve to be always busy and in business for a long time 🙏

reviews.text: Had the vegan chicken katsu and kimchi, food was fast, fresh and tasty! The service from Xuan H was lovely too - warm, welcoming and accommodating. We will definitely be back

reviews.author: Amy Chan
reviews.text: If you come from Asia, please know that this place is made for British taste. It is not authentic at all. The staff were friendly but unfortunately I came here for the food.

reviews.author: KT
reviews.text: The sashimi was okay, tempura was good, anything with rice is terrible. Will not go back again.

reviews.author: Antheia B
reviews.text: Far from authentic, not sanitary and highly overpriced for the quality of food. I sat and watched the chefs pull pre-cut slices of raw fish out of a bag or get given them on plates from the back. The least you could do for charging your customers 88£ each is give them fresh ingredients. Everything was pulled from bags and boxes. The online images do not match what you serve. Soya sauce is for some reason in a beautician bottle pipette. An insult to Japanese food, a tourist trap at best.

reviews.author: Tessa Koreman
reviews.text: Best sushi ever! Also the staff was lovely. We tried different roles and some hand rolls. Everything was insane. Loved the tuna hand rolls. We also had the chef’s special, which is definitely recommended! Also the karagga
